title: Audit: Financial Red Tape
description: Audit: Financial Red Tape — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Soldier Clohz of Yorbahk

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go Collect 30 Receipts and 6 Expense Reports from the Poison Whiskers and Poison Demon Spawn in Upper Widowers Nest.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Soldier Clohz of Yorbahk

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Widower's Nest

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go Collect 30 Receipts and 6 Expense Reports from the Poison Whiskers and Poison Demon Spawn in Upper Widowers Nest.

Offer:

We got a batch of Expense Reports and Receipts in, but there has been nothing new since so I need you to go and work your 'magic' on those lazy monsters.

The Receipts are easy to come by, but remember to book a conference with the Poison Whisker and Demon Spawn Leaders to get the Expense Reports.

Go and collect Receipts and Expense Reports from the Poison Whiskers and Poison Demon Spawn in Upper Widower's Nest. Return to me, Soldier Clohz of Yorbahk, here on Level 1 of the Widower's Nest when you are through.

Turn-in:

You are a paperwork guru! Let me know when you want to give it another go.

Objectives:

  • Receipts ×30
  • Expense Reports ×6

Level range: 20–40
